name: Logicrays Loop Builder for Elementor
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
Logicrays Loop Builder for Elementor lets you create powerful and flexible post layouts directly within Elementor—without complex coding.

Key Features

  • Multiple Layout Options: Grid, List, Featured + Grid, and News layouts
  • AJAX Filtering: Filter posts instantly without page reload
  • Live Search & Sorting: Search posts and sort by title or description
  • Flexible Pagination: Numbered pagination, Load More, and Infinite Scroll
  • Dynamic Taxonomy Filtering: Filter using categories, tags, or custom taxonomies
  • Custom Post Card Controls: Show or hide title, image, date, author, categories, tags, and read more button
  • Fast AJAX Loading: Smooth and seamless content updates
  • Responsive Design: Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Elementor Integration: Fully compatible with Elementor editor and live preview

Layout Options

  • Grid Layout: Clean multi-column layout for posts
  • List Layout: Simple vertical list format
  • Featured + Grid Layout: Highlight one post with grid below
  • News Layout: Structured layout ideal for blogs and news websites

Pagination Options

  • None: Display limited posts without pagination
  • Numbered Pages: Traditional pagination with page numbers
  • Load More Button: Load posts dynamically on button click
  • Infinite Scroll: Automatically load posts on scroll

Use Cases

  • Blogs and content websites
  • News and magazine sites
  • Portfolio and showcase pages
  • Business websites
  • Custom post type listings

Privacy & Security

  • No data is sent to external services
  • No tracking or analytics used
  • Secure and lightweight implementation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/logicrays-loop-builder-for-elementor directory, or install through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor.
  4. Add the “Logicrays Loop Grid” widget.
  5. Configure layout, filters, and query settings as needed.
sections.faq:
What is Logicrays Loop Builder?

It is a custom Elementor widget that allows you to create dynamic post layouts with AJAX filtering and advanced query controls.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. You can fully manage layouts, filters, and settings directly from the Elementor panel.

Does it support AJAX filtering?

Yes. All filters work instantly without reloading the page.

What layouts are available?

Grid, List, Featured + Grid, and News layouts.

What pagination options are available?

None, Numbered Pagination, Load More, and Infinite Scroll.

Can I customize post cards?

Yes. You can control visibility of title, image, date, author, categories, tags, and more.

Is it responsive?

Yes. The plugin is fully responsive across all devices.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes. It works with most WordPress themes that support Elementor.

What are the technical requirements?

WordPress 6.0 or higher, PHP 8.2 or higher, and the Elementor plugin installed and activated.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Plugin Check compliance: i18n translators comments, output escaping, and safe transient cleanup.
  • Code standards cleanup across plugin PHP files.
  • Fixed news layout category links on the frontend.
  • Improved query transient caching (stores post IDs instead of WP_Query objects).

1.0.1

  • WordPress.org review fixes: unique llbe/LLBE prefixes, removed invalid Plugin URI.
  • Renamed legacy JavaScript identifiers to LLBE prefix.
  • Restricted editor taxonomy AJAX to authenticated users with edit_posts capability.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
